versions.content: Caveats of EcuM_StartupTwo: This function must be called from a task, which is started directly as a consequence of StartOS. I.e. either the EcuM_StartupTwo function must be called from an autostart task or the EcuM_Startup Two function must be called from a task, which is explicitly started.
